metadata.title: MPAS quasi-uniform x1.10242 (N=10242 cells, ~120 km)
metadata.description: MPAS Voronoi mesh with 10242 cells, 30720 edges, max_edges=6. Quasi-uniform global sphere; 12 pentagons + 10230 hexagons. Constructed algorithmically as the Voronoi dual of DUO icosahedral subdivision level 5 (10*4^5+2=10242 vertices).
